findings.title: Forces UTF-8 decoding and breaks on non-UTF-8 text responses
findings.evidence: The function always decodes the downloaded bytes with UTF-8 regardless of the response encoding, so any valid text payload served as latin-1, cp1252, shift_jis, etc. will now raise UnicodeDecodeError instead of returning text.
findings.recommendation: Decode using the response's declared/apparent encoding, for example via response.text after enforcing the byte cap, or use response.encoding with a safe fallback instead of hard-coding UTF-8.

findings.title: No test coverage for decoding behavior despite new text-returning API
findings.evidence: The implementation's only return path is a hard-coded UTF-8 decode, but the change context states no tests were run, leaving a high-risk behavior unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add tests covering at least UTF-8 and a non-UTF-8 text response with a declared charset, plus an oversized body path, before relying on this helper.
